components.scope: unexecuted producer specification with producer fixtures: docs/architecture/runtime-producer-contract-v1.md names roles only and pins versions (contract 1, wire 15, run request schema 2, declarations schema 4, job status 1, ended-run histories 1 and the parts they hold), the transport, each record's members, absence, seal and verification function, and the consumer's obligations; fixtures/runtime-producer/v1 holds eight records and a manifest of their digests, built by the host test module runtime_producer_contract_tests from the runtime's own types (a controlled-write coding run held to the committed repair recipe sample, its declarations with every part present and with every part absent, a cancellation request with its answer and the job status, and three stored chains), reproduced byte for byte, decoded exactly and verified as the client verifies them, with an added member refused at every object position and changed records refused or dropped; scripts/runtime_producer_fixtures.py regenerates or compares them through an ignored printing test, and tests/test_runtime_producer_contract.py checks the manifest digests and the document. No consumer has read these records; it is not a consumer contract, counterpart approval or integration proof

mutation_checks: run before the source commit with private tooling, each applying one exact replacement and running the package filter: 17 single mutations over the closed recipe variants (three enums opened), exact decoding (the comparison dropped, plain decoding of requests and of responses, any version accepted in either direction), each identity term of the declared-plan check, and the declared plan's validation shape checks (registry digest, validation identity, template digest, empty identity, any byte); all 17 made their expected test fail at once. These runs are not retained logs. The serving loop and the client exchange that call the exact decoders are glue run only by actual processes; the observation exercised them
